entities.summary: Jesús María de la Villa Garcia is a Spanish chess grandmaster. He won the Spanish Chess Championship twice, in 1985 and 1988. He is a chess author and coach. In 2010 he was awarded the title of FIDE Senior Trainer.

entities.summary: Jesús María de la Villa Garcia is a Spanish chess grandmaster. He won the Spanish Chess Championship twice, in 1985 and 1988. He is a chess author and coach. In 2010 he was awarded the title of FIDE Senior Trainer.
